title: My Horse Glory
moral: Take care of your responsibilities and fix your mistakes.

scenes.summary: Tory introduces herself, her farm, and her horse Glory.
scenes.text: My name is Tory. I live on a farm. I have a horse. Her name is Glory.
scenes.image_prompt: young girl on a farm smiling beside her horse, barn and fields in background, colorful cartoon style

scenes.summary: Tory forgets to close the gate and Glory escapes.
scenes.text: Glory plays in her corral. I forgot to close the gate, and Glory got out.
scenes.image_prompt: horse escaping through open gate in a farm corral, girl looking surprised, bright cartoon illustration

scenes.summary: Tory searches for Glory after realizing she is missing.
scenes.image_prompt: girl searching for her lost horse around farm with worried expression, colorful cartoon style

scenes.summary: Tory finds Glory hurt and calls the animal doctor.
scenes.text: I found her with a thorn in her foot. I called the animal doctor for help.
scenes.image_prompt: girl finding horse with injured foot and calling a veterinarian, caring scene, cartoon illustration

scenes.summary: Glory is treated and returns to normal.
scenes.text: Now Glory is back to normal.
scenes.image_prompt: happy girl hugging healthy horse with veterinarian nearby, sunny farm setting, colorful cartoon style

story: My name is Tory. I live on a farm. I have a horse. Her name is Glory. Glory plays in her corral. I forgot to close the gate, and Glory got out. I had to find her! I found her with a thorn in her foot. I called the animal doctor for help. Now Glory is back to normal.
